<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.mapper.CapacityDBMapper">
    <insert id="insertVenueResults">
        INSERT INTO T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT (SCENE_ID,
                                                            PACKAGE_ID,
                                                            DATE_KEY,
                                                            BLOCK_NAME,
                                                            RESULT,
                                                            RESOURCE_SHORTFALL_CELL,
                                                            ABNORMAL_CELL,
                                                            DEACTIVE_CELL)
        VALUES (#{result.sceneId},
                #{result.packageId},
                #{dateKey},
                #{result.blockName},
                #{result.result},
                #{result.resourceShortfallCell},
                #{result.abnormalCell},
                #{result.deactiveCell})
    </insert>
    <insert id="insertSpotOrTransportResults">
        INSERT INTO T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT (SCENE_ID,
                                                       PACKAGE_ID,
                                                       DATE_KEY,
                                                       RESULT,
                                                       REMARK,
                                                       DEACTIVE_CELL)
        VALUES (#{result.sceneId},
                #{result.packageId},
                #{dateKey},
                #{result.result},
                #{result.remark},
                #{result.deactiveCell})
    </insert>

    <!-- 更新场景预估任务状态 -->
    <update id="updatePredictTaskStatus">
        UPDATE T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        SET PREDICT_SWITCH = #{status}
        WHERE CITY_CODE = #{civicAddress.a3}
          and SCENE_CODE = #{civicAddress.loc}
          and SCENE_TYPE =
              CASE #{civicAddress.plc}
                  WHEN 'CG' THEN 0
                  WHEN 'JTSN' THEN 1
                  WHEN 'JQ' THEN 2
                  ELSE -1
                END
    </update>
    <delete id="deleteRegionBlockResults">
        BEGIN
        DELETE FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
        WHERE SCENE_ID IN
        <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            #{sceneId}
        </foreach>;
        DELETE FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT
        WHERE SCENE_ID IN
        <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            #{sceneId}
        </foreach>;
        END;
    </delete>

    <select id="getLatestRegionPeriodBySceneId" resultType="java.sql.Timestamp">
        select max(DATE_KEY)
        from  T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
        <if test="sceneIds != null">
            WHERE SCENE_ID IN
            <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                #{sceneId}
            </foreach>
        </if>
    </select>

    <!-- 查询区域结果 -->
    <select id="getRegionResults" resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.RegionResult">
        SELECT
            RESULT.sceneId,
            SCENE.SCENE_TYPE AS sceneType,
            SCENE.SCENE_CODE AS sceneCode,
            SCENE.CITY_CODE AS cityCode,
            RESULT.blockName,
            RESULT.packageId,
            PACKAGE.PACKAGE_CODE AS packageCode,
            RESULT.dateKey,
            RESULT.result,
            RESULT.remark,
            RESULT.resourceShortfallCell,
            RESULT.abnormalCell,
            RESULT.deactiveCell
        FROM
        (SELECT
            SCENE_ID as sceneId,
            PACKAGE_ID AS packageId,
            '' as blockName,
            DATE_KEY as dateKey,
            RESULT as result,
            REMARK as remark,
            0 AS resourceShortfallCell,
            0 AS abnormalCell,
            DEACTIVE_CELL AS deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT RESULT
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            SCENE_ID as sceneId,
            PACKAGE_ID AS packageId,
            BLOCK_NAME as blockName,
            DATE_KEY as dateKey,
            RESULT as result,
            0 as remark,
            RESOURCE_SHORTFALL_CELL as resourceShortfallCell,
            ABNORMAL_CELL as abnormalCell,
            DEACTIVE_CELL AS deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT) RESULT
        INNER JOIN T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE SCENE ON RESULT.sceneId = SCENE.SCENE_ID
        INNER JOIN T_MBB_ALLOC_EVA_PACKAGE PACKAGE ON RESULT.packageId = PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID
        WHERE (SCENE.CITY_CODE,
               CASE SCENE.SCENE_TYPE
                WHEN 0 THEN 'CG'
                WHEN 1 THEN 'JTSN'
                WHEN 2 THEN 'JQ'
                END,
               SCENE.SCENE_CODE) in
        <foreach collection="civicAddresses" item="civicAddress" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            (#{civicAddress.a3}, #{civicAddress.plc}, #{civicAddress.loc})
        </foreach>
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneInfos"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.SceneInfo">
        SELECT
        SCENE_ID AS sceneId,
        SCENE_TYPE as sceneType,
        SCENE_CODE as sceneCode,
        RELATE_REGION_ID as relateRegionId,
        CITY_CODE as cityCode,
        PREDICT_SWITCH as predictSwitch,
        DUTY_RATIO as dutyRatio
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        <if test="sceneIds != null">
            WHERE SCENE_ID IN
            <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                #{sceneId}
            </foreach>
        </if>
    </select>
    <select id="getAllRegionResults"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.RegionResult">
        SELECT SCENE_ID      AS sceneId,
               PACKAGE_ID    AS packageId,
               DATE_KEY      as dateKey,
               RESULT        as result,
               REMARK        as remark,
               DEACTIVE_CELL as deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
        WHERE DATE_KEY = #{regionDateKey}
    </select>
    <select id="getAllBlockResults"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.RegionResult">
        SELECT SCENE_ID                as sceneId,
               PACKAGE_ID              as packageId,
               DATE_KEY                as dateKey,
               BLOCK_NAME              as blockName,
               RESULT                  as result,
               RESOURCE_SHORTFALL_CELL as resourceShortfallCell,
               ABNORMAL_CELL           as abnormalCell,
               DEACTIVE_CELL           as deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT
        WHERE DATE_KEY = #{blockDateKey}
    </select>
    <select id="getRegionMaxDateKey" resultType="java.sql.Timestamp">
        select max(DATE_KEY)
        from  T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
    </select>
    <select id="getBlockMaxDateKey" resultType="java.sql.Timestamp">
        select max(DATE_KEY)
        from  T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneInfo" resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.SceneInfo">
        SELECT
            SCENE_ID AS sceneId,
            SCENE_TYPE as sceneType,
            SCENE_CODE as sceneCode,
            RELATE_REGION_ID as relateRegionId,
            CITY_CODE as cityCode,
            DUTY_RATIO as dutyRatio
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        WHERE CITY_CODE = #{civicAddress.a3}
          AND SCENE_CODE = #{civicAddress.loc}
          AND SCENE_TYPE =
              CASE #{civicAddress.plc}
                  WHEN 'CG' THEN 0
                  WHEN 'JTSN' THEN 1
                  WHEN 'JQ' THEN 2
                  ELSE -1
                END
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneInfosByCivicAddresses" resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.SceneInfo">
        SELECT
            SCENE_ID AS sceneId,
            SCENE_TYPE as sceneType,
            SCENE_CODE as sceneCode,
            RELATE_REGION_ID as relateRegionId,
            CITY_CODE as cityCode,
            DUTY_RATIO as dutyRatio
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE SCENE
        WHERE (SCENE.CITY_CODE, CASE SCENE.SCENE_TYPE
        WHEN 0 THEN 'CG'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'JTSN'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'JQ'
        END,
        SCENE.SCENE_CODE) in
        <foreach collection="civicAddresses" item="civicAddress" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            (#{civicAddress.a3}, #{civicAddress.plc}, #{civicAddress.loc})
        </foreach>
    </select>
    <select id="getPackageInfos"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.venuealloc.impl.bean.PackageInfo">
        SELECT PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID           AS packageId,
               PACKAGE.PACKAGE_NAME         AS packageName,
               PACKAGE.PACKAGE_CODE         AS packageCode,
               PACKAGE.UL_TARGET_THROUGHPUT AS ulGuaranteedRate,
               PACKAGE.DL_TARGET_THROUGHPUT AS dlGuaranteedRate,
               SCENE.UL_RB_WEIGHT AS ulRbWeight,
               SCENE.DL_RB_WEIGHT AS dlRbWeight,
               PACKAGE.DURATION_HOURS       AS durationHours,
               PACKAGE.QCI                  AS qci
        FROM T_MBB_ALLOC_EVA_PACKAGE PACKAGE
                 INNER JOIN T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_PACKAGE SCENE
                            ON PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID = SCENE.PACKAGE_ID AND SCENE.SCENE_ID = #{sceneId}
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneCells"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.AllocResult">
        SELECT distinct RANNE.NE_ID     as neId,
               CELLS.NODEBID AS gNodeBId,
               CELLS.CELLID   AS cellId,
               CASE
                   WHEN RANNE.SUBSCRIBESTATUS != 1 THEN 'prs.venuealloc.cannotalloc.nosubscribe'
                   WHEN RANNE.NE_ID IS NULL THEN 'prs.venuealloc.cannotalloc.noActive'
                   ELSE ''
                   END         AS remark
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_CELL CELL
            LEFT JOIN T_MBB_RANNE_EXT RANNE ON CELL.GNODEB_ID = RANNE.LOGIC_NEID
                 LEFT JOIN T_DTHR_CELL CELLS ON CELLS.NODEBID = RANNE.LOGIC_NEID AND RANNE.MODE_ID = 12 AND CELLS.OBJECTTYPEID = 'NRCell'
                 LEFT JOIN T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SUBSCRIBE SPIRIT
                           ON RANNE.NE_ID = SPIRIT.NE_ID AND RANNE.PRIMARYOSSID = SPIRIT.OSS_ID
        where CELL.SCENE_ID = #{sceneId}
    </select>
    <select id="getVenueHistResults"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.AllocResult">
        SELECT #{sceneId}                as sceneId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.NE_ID        as gNodeBId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.CELL_ID      as cellId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.PACKAGE_ID   as packageId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.ALLOC_RESULT as result,
               ALLOC_RESULT.REMARK       as remark
        FROM T_MBB_VENUE_ALLOC_RESULT ALLOC_RESULT
                 INNER JOIN T_MBB_ALLOC_EVA_TASK_PACKAGE TASK_PACKAGE
                            ON ALLOC_RESULT.TASK_ID = TASK_PACKAGE.TASK_ID AND
                               ALLOC_RESULT.PACKAGE_ID = TASK_PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID
        WHERE ALLOC_RESULT.TASK_ID =
              (SELECT ALLOC_TASK_ID FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_TASK WHERE SCENE_ID = #{sceneId} order by TASK_ID DESC LIMIT 1
            )
        ORDER BY ALLOC_RESULT.NE_ID, ALLOC_RESULT.CELL_ID, ALLOC_RESULT.PACKAGE_ID
    </select>
</mapper>

<mapper namespace="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.mapper.CapacityDBMapper">
    <insert id="insertVenueResults">
        INSERT INTO T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT (SCENE_ID,
                                                            PACKAGE_ID,
                                                            DATE_KEY,
                                                            BLOCK_NAME,
                                                            RESULT,
                                                            RESOURCE_SHORTFALL_CELL,
                                                            ABNORMAL_CELL,
                                                            DEACTIVE_CELL)
        VALUES (#{result.sceneId},
                #{result.packageId},
                #{dateKey},
                #{result.blockName},
                #{result.result},
                #{result.resourceShortfallCell},
                #{result.abnormalCell},
                #{result.deactiveCell})
    </insert>
    <insert id="insertSpotOrTransportResults">
        INSERT INTO T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT (SCENE_ID,
                                                       PACKAGE_ID,
                                                       DATE_KEY,
                                                       RESULT,
                                                       REMARK,
                                                       DEACTIVE_CELL)
        VALUES (#{result.sceneId},
                #{result.packageId},
                #{dateKey},
                #{result.result},
                #{result.remark},
                #{result.deactiveCell})
    </insert>

    <!-- 更新场景预估任务状态 -->
    <update id="updatePredictTaskStatus">
        UPDATE T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        SET PREDICT_SWITCH = #{status}
        WHERE CITY_CODE = #{civicAddress.a3}
          and SCENE_CODE = #{civicAddress.loc}
          and SCENE_TYPE =
              CASE #{civicAddress.plc}
                  WHEN 'CG' THEN 0
                  WHEN 'JTSN' THEN 1
                  WHEN 'JQ' THEN 2
                  ELSE -1
                END
    </update>
    <delete id="deleteRegionBlockResults">
        BEGIN
        DELETE FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
        WHERE SCENE_ID IN
        <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            #{sceneId}
        </foreach>;
        DELETE FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT
        WHERE SCENE_ID IN
        <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            #{sceneId}
        </foreach>;
        END;
    </delete>

    <select id="getLatestRegionPeriodBySceneId" resultType="java.sql.Timestamp">
        select max(DATE_KEY)
        from  T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
        <if test="sceneIds != null">
            WHERE SCENE_ID IN
            <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                #{sceneId}
            </foreach>
        </if>
    </select>

    <!-- 查询区域结果 -->
    <select id="getRegionResults" resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.RegionResult">
        SELECT
            RESULT.sceneId,
            SCENE.SCENE_TYPE AS sceneType,
            SCENE.SCENE_CODE AS sceneCode,
            SCENE.CITY_CODE AS cityCode,
            RESULT.blockName,
            RESULT.packageId,
            PACKAGE.PACKAGE_CODE AS packageCode,
            RESULT.dateKey,
            RESULT.result,
            RESULT.remark,
            RESULT.resourceShortfallCell,
            RESULT.abnormalCell,
            RESULT.deactiveCell
        FROM
        (SELECT
            SCENE_ID as sceneId,
            PACKAGE_ID AS packageId,
            '' as blockName,
            DATE_KEY as dateKey,
            RESULT as result,
            REMARK as remark,
            0 AS resourceShortfallCell,
            0 AS abnormalCell,
            DEACTIVE_CELL AS deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT RESULT
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            SCENE_ID as sceneId,
            PACKAGE_ID AS packageId,
            BLOCK_NAME as blockName,
            DATE_KEY as dateKey,
            RESULT as result,
            0 as remark,
            RESOURCE_SHORTFALL_CELL as resourceShortfallCell,
            ABNORMAL_CELL as abnormalCell,
            DEACTIVE_CELL AS deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT) RESULT
        INNER JOIN T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE SCENE ON RESULT.sceneId = SCENE.SCENE_ID
        INNER JOIN T_MBB_ALLOC_EVA_PACKAGE PACKAGE ON RESULT.packageId = PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID
        WHERE (SCENE.CITY_CODE,
               CASE SCENE.SCENE_TYPE
                WHEN 0 THEN 'CG'
                WHEN 1 THEN 'JTSN'
                WHEN 2 THEN 'JQ'
                END,
               SCENE.SCENE_CODE) in
        <foreach collection="civicAddresses" item="civicAddress" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            (#{civicAddress.a3}, #{civicAddress.plc}, #{civicAddress.loc})
        </foreach>
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneInfos"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.SceneInfo">
        SELECT
        SCENE_ID AS sceneId,
        SCENE_TYPE as sceneType,
        SCENE_CODE as sceneCode,
        RELATE_REGION_ID as relateRegionId,
        CITY_CODE as cityCode,
        PREDICT_SWITCH as predictSwitch,
        DUTY_RATIO as dutyRatio
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        <if test="sceneIds != null">
            WHERE SCENE_ID IN
            <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                #{sceneId}
            </foreach>
        </if>
    </select>
    <select id="getAllRegionResults"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.RegionResult">
        SELECT SCENE_ID      AS sceneId,
               PACKAGE_ID    AS packageId,
               DATE_KEY      as dateKey,
               RESULT        as result,
               REMARK        as remark,
               DEACTIVE_CELL as deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
        WHERE DATE_KEY = #{regionDateKey}
    </select>
    <select id="getAllBlockResults"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.RegionResult">
        SELECT SCENE_ID                as sceneId,
               PACKAGE_ID              as packageId,
               DATE_KEY                as dateKey,
               BLOCK_NAME              as blockName,
               RESULT                  as result,
               RESOURCE_SHORTFALL_CELL as resourceShortfallCell,
               ABNORMAL_CELL           as abnormalCell,
               DEACTIVE_CELL           as deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT
        WHERE DATE_KEY = #{blockDateKey}
    </select>
    <select id="getRegionMaxDateKey" resultType="java.sql.Timestamp">
        select max(DATE_KEY)
        from  T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
    </select>
    <select id="getBlockMaxDateKey" resultType="java.sql.Timestamp">
        select max(DATE_KEY)
        from  T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneInfo" resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.SceneInfo">
        SELECT
            SCENE_ID AS sceneId,
            SCENE_TYPE as sceneType,
            SCENE_CODE as sceneCode,
            RELATE_REGION_ID as relateRegionId,
            CITY_CODE as cityCode,
            DUTY_RATIO as dutyRatio
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        WHERE CITY_CODE = #{civicAddress.a3}
          AND SCENE_CODE = #{civicAddress.loc}
          AND SCENE_TYPE =
              CASE #{civicAddress.plc}
                  WHEN 'CG' THEN 0
                  WHEN 'JTSN' THEN 1
                  WHEN 'JQ' THEN 2
                  ELSE -1
                END
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneInfosByCivicAddresses" resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.SceneInfo">
        SELECT
            SCENE_ID AS sceneId,
            SCENE_TYPE as sceneType,
            SCENE_CODE as sceneCode,
            RELATE_REGION_ID as relateRegionId,
            CITY_CODE as cityCode,
            DUTY_RATIO as dutyRatio
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE SCENE
        WHERE (SCENE.CITY_CODE, CASE SCENE.SCENE_TYPE
        WHEN 0 THEN 'CG'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'JTSN'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'JQ'
        END,
        SCENE.SCENE_CODE) in
        <foreach collection="civicAddresses" item="civicAddress" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            (#{civicAddress.a3}, #{civicAddress.plc}, #{civicAddress.loc})
        </foreach>
    </select>
    <select id="getPackageInfos"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.venuealloc.impl.bean.PackageInfo">
        SELECT PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID           AS packageId,
               PACKAGE.PACKAGE_NAME         AS packageName,
               PACKAGE.PACKAGE_CODE         AS packageCode,
               PACKAGE.UL_TARGET_THROUGHPUT AS ulGuaranteedRate,
               PACKAGE.DL_TARGET_THROUGHPUT AS dlGuaranteedRate,
               SCENE.UL_RB_WEIGHT AS ulRbWeight,
               SCENE.DL_RB_WEIGHT AS dlRbWeight,
               PACKAGE.DURATION_HOURS       AS durationHours,
               PACKAGE.QCI                  AS qci
        FROM T_MBB_ALLOC_EVA_PACKAGE PACKAGE
                 INNER JOIN T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_PACKAGE SCENE
                            ON PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID = SCENE.PACKAGE_ID AND SCENE.SCENE_ID = #{sceneId}
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneCells"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.AllocResult">
        SELECT distinct RANNE.NE_ID     as neId,
               CELLS.NODEBID AS gNodeBId,
               CELLS.CELLID   AS cellId,
               CASE
                   WHEN RANNE.SUBSCRIBESTATUS != 1 THEN 'prs.venuealloc.cannotalloc.nosubscribe'
                   WHEN RANNE.NE_ID IS NULL THEN 'prs.venuealloc.cannotalloc.noActive'
                   ELSE ''
                   END         AS remark
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_CELL CELL
            LEFT JOIN T_MBB_RANNE_EXT RANNE ON CELL.GNODEB_ID = RANNE.LOGIC_NEID
                 LEFT JOIN T_DTHR_CELL CELLS ON CELLS.NODEBID = RANNE.LOGIC_NEID AND RANNE.MODE_ID = 12 AND CELLS.OBJECTTYPEID = 'NRCell'
                 LEFT JOIN T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SUBSCRIBE SPIRIT
                           ON RANNE.NE_ID = SPIRIT.NE_ID AND RANNE.PRIMARYOSSID = SPIRIT.OSS_ID
        where CELL.SCENE_ID = #{sceneId}
    </select>
    <select id="getVenueHistResults"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.AllocResult">
        SELECT #{sceneId}                as sceneId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.NE_ID        as gNodeBId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.CELL_ID      as cellId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.PACKAGE_ID   as packageId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.ALLOC_RESULT as result,
               ALLOC_RESULT.REMARK       as remark
        FROM T_MBB_VENUE_ALLOC_RESULT ALLOC_RESULT
                 INNER JOIN T_MBB_ALLOC_EVA_TASK_PACKAGE TASK_PACKAGE
                            ON ALLOC_RESULT.TASK_ID = TASK_PACKAGE.TASK_ID AND
                               ALLOC_RESULT.PACKAGE_ID = TASK_PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID
        WHERE ALLOC_RESULT.TASK_ID =
              (SELECT ALLOC_TASK_ID FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_TASK WHERE SCENE_ID = #{sceneId} order by TASK_ID DESC LIMIT 1
            )
        ORDER BY ALLOC_RESULT.NE_ID, ALLOC_RESULT.CELL_ID, ALLOC_RESULT.PACKAGE_ID
    </select>
</mapper>

{"content": "<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.mapper.CapacityDBMapper">
    <insert id="insertVenueResults">
        INSERT INTO T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT (SCENE_ID,
                                                            PACKAGE_ID,
                                                            DATE_KEY,
                                                            BLOCK_NAME,
                                                            RESULT,
                                                            RESOURCE_SHORTFALL_CELL,
                                                            ABNORMAL_CELL,
                                                            DEACTIVE_CELL)
        VALUES (#{result.sceneId},
                #{result.packageId},
                #{dateKey},
                #{result.blockName},
                #{result.result},
                #{result.resourceShortfallCell},
                #{result.abnormalCell},
                #{result.deactiveCell})
    </insert>
    <insert id="insertSpotOrTransportResults">
        INSERT INTO T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT (SCENE_ID,
                                                       PACKAGE_ID,
                                                       DATE_KEY,
                                                       RESULT,
                                                       REMARK,
                                                       DEACTIVE_CELL)
        VALUES (#{result.sceneId},
                #{result.packageId},
                #{dateKey},
                #{result.result},
                #{result.remark},
                #{result.deactiveCell})
    </insert>

    <!-- 更新场景预估任务状态 -->
    <update id="updatePredictTaskStatus">
        UPDATE T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        SET PREDICT_SWITCH = #{status}
        WHERE CITY_CODE = #{civicAddress.a3}
          and SCENE_CODE = #{civicAddress.loc}
          and SCENE_TYPE =
              CASE #{civicAddress.plc}
                  WHEN 'CG' THEN 0
                  WHEN 'JTSN' THEN 1
                  WHEN 'JQ' THEN 2
                  ELSE -1
                END
    </update>
    <delete id="deleteRegionBlockResults">
        BEGIN
        DELETE FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
        WHERE SCENE_ID IN
        <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            #{sceneId}
        </foreach>;
        DELETE FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT
        WHERE SCENE_ID IN
        <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            #{sceneId}
        </foreach>;
        END;
    </delete>

    <select id="getLatestRegionPeriodBySceneId" resultType="java.sql.Timestamp">
        select max(DATE_KEY)
        from  T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
        <if test="sceneIds != null">
            WHERE SCENE_ID IN
            <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                #{sceneId}
            </foreach>
        </if>
    </select>

    <!-- 查询区域结果 -->
    <select id="getRegionResults" resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.RegionResult">
        SELECT
            RESULT.sceneId,
            SCENE.SCENE_TYPE AS sceneType,
            SCENE.SCENE_CODE AS sceneCode,
            SCENE.CITY_CODE AS cityCode,
            RESULT.blockName,
            RESULT.packageId,
            PACKAGE.PACKAGE_CODE AS packageCode,
            RESULT.dateKey,
            RESULT.result,
            RESULT.remark,
            RESULT.resourceShortfallCell,
            RESULT.abnormalCell,
            RESULT.deactiveCell
        FROM
        (SELECT
            SCENE_ID as sceneId,
            PACKAGE_ID AS packageId,
            '' as blockName,
            DATE_KEY as dateKey,
            RESULT as result,
            REMARK as remark,
            0 AS resourceShortfallCell,
            0 AS abnormalCell,
            DEACTIVE_CELL AS deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT RESULT
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            SCENE_ID as sceneId,
            PACKAGE_ID AS packageId,
            BLOCK_NAME as blockName,
            DATE_KEY as dateKey,
            RESULT as result,
            0 as remark,
            RESOURCE_SHORTFALL_CELL as resourceShortfallCell,
            ABNORMAL_CELL as abnormalCell,
            DEACTIVE_CELL AS deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT) RESULT
        INNER JOIN T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE SCENE ON RESULT.sceneId = SCENE.SCENE_ID
        INNER JOIN T_MBB_ALLOC_EVA_PACKAGE PACKAGE ON RESULT.packageId = PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID
        WHERE (SCENE.CITY_CODE,
               CASE SCENE.SCENE_TYPE
                WHEN 0 THEN 'CG'
                WHEN 1 THEN 'JTSN'
                WHEN 2 THEN 'JQ'
                END,
               SCENE.SCENE_CODE) in
        <foreach collection="civicAddresses" item="civicAddress" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            (#{civicAddress.a3}, #{civicAddress.plc}, #{civicAddress.loc})
        </foreach>
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneInfos"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.SceneInfo">
        SELECT
        SCENE_ID AS sceneId,
        SCENE_TYPE as sceneType,
        SCENE_CODE as sceneCode,
        RELATE_REGION_ID as relateRegionId,
        CITY_CODE as cityCode,
        PREDICT_SWITCH as predictSwitch,
        DUTY_RATIO as dutyRatio
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        <if test="sceneIds != null">
            WHERE SCENE_ID IN
            <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                #{sceneId}
            </foreach>
        </if>
    </select>
    <select id="getAllRegionResults"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.RegionResult">
        SELECT SCENE_ID      AS sceneId,
               PACKAGE_ID    AS packageId,
               DATE_KEY      as dateKey,
               RESULT        as result,
               REMARK        as remark,
               DEACTIVE_CELL as deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
        WHERE DATE_KEY = #{regionDateKey}
    </select>
    <select id="getAllBlockResults"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.RegionResult">
        SELECT SCENE_ID                as sceneId,
               PACKAGE_ID              as packageId,
               DATE_KEY                as dateKey,
               BLOCK_NAME              as blockName,
               RESULT                  as result,
               RESOURCE_SHORTFALL_CELL as resourceShortfallCell,
               ABNORMAL_CELL           as abnormalCell,
               DEACTIVE_CELL           as deactiveCell
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT
        WHERE DATE_KEY = #{blockDateKey}
    </select>
    <select id="getRegionMaxDateKey" resultType="java.sql.Timestamp">
        select max(DATE_KEY)
        from  T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_REGION_RESULT
    </select>
    <select id="getBlockMaxDateKey" resultType="java.sql.Timestamp">
        select max(DATE_KEY)
        from  T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_VENUE_BLOCK_RESULT
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneInfo" resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.SceneInfo">
        SELECT
            SCENE_ID AS sceneId,
            SCENE_TYPE as sceneType,
            SCENE_CODE as sceneCode,
            RELATE_REGION_ID as relateRegionId,
            CITY_CODE as cityCode,
            DUTY_RATIO as dutyRatio
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        WHERE CITY_CODE = #{civicAddress.a3}
          AND SCENE_CODE = #{civicAddress.loc}
          AND SCENE_TYPE =
              CASE #{civicAddress.plc}
                  WHEN 'CG' THEN 0
                  WHEN 'JTSN' THEN 1
                  WHEN 'JQ' THEN 2
                  ELSE -1
                END
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneInfosByCivicAddresses" resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.SceneInfo">
        SELECT
            SCENE_ID AS sceneId,
            SCENE_TYPE as sceneType,
            SCENE_CODE as sceneCode,
            RELATE_REGION_ID as relateRegionId,
            CITY_CODE as cityCode,
            DUTY_RATIO as dutyRatio
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE SCENE
        WHERE (SCENE.CITY_CODE, CASE SCENE.SCENE_TYPE
        WHEN 0 THEN 'CG'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'JTSN'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'JQ'
        END,
        SCENE.SCENE_CODE) in
        <foreach collection="civicAddresses" item="civicAddress" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            (#{civicAddress.a3}, #{civicAddress.plc}, #{civicAddress.loc})
        </foreach>
    </select>
    <select id="getPackageInfos"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.venuealloc.impl.bean.PackageInfo">
        SELECT PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID           AS packageId,
               PACKAGE.PACKAGE_NAME         AS packageName,
               PACKAGE.PACKAGE_CODE         AS packageCode,
               PACKAGE.UL_TARGET_THROUGHPUT AS ulGuaranteedRate,
               PACKAGE.DL_TARGET_THROUGHPUT AS dlGuaranteedRate,
               SCENE.UL_RB_WEIGHT AS ulRbWeight,
               SCENE.DL_RB_WEIGHT AS dlRbWeight,
               PACKAGE.DURATION_HOURS       AS durationHours,
               PACKAGE.QCI                  AS qci
        FROM T_MBB_ALLOC_EVA_PACKAGE PACKAGE
                 INNER JOIN T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_PACKAGE SCENE
                            ON PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID = SCENE.PACKAGE_ID AND SCENE.SCENE_ID = #{sceneId}
    </select>
    <select id="getSceneCells"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.AllocResult">
        SELECT distinct RANNE.NE_ID     as neId,
               CELLS.NODEBID AS gNodeBId,
               CELLS.CELLID   AS cellId,
               CASE
                   WHEN RANNE.SUBSCRIBESTATUS != 1 THEN 'prs.venuealloc.cannotalloc.nosubscribe'
                   WHEN RANNE.NE_ID IS NULL THEN 'prs.venuealloc.cannotalloc.noActive'
                   ELSE ''
                   END         AS remark
        FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_CELL CELL
            LEFT JOIN T_MBB_RANNE_EXT RANNE ON CELL.GNODEB_ID = RANNE.LOGIC_NEID
                 LEFT JOIN T_DTHR_CELL CELLS ON CELLS.NODEBID = RANNE.LOGIC_NEID AND RANNE.MODE_ID = 12 AND CELLS.OBJECTTYPEID = 'NRCell'
                 LEFT JOIN T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SUBSCRIBE SPIRIT
                           ON RANNE.NE_ID = SPIRIT.NE_ID AND RANNE.PRIMARYOSSID = SPIRIT.OSS_ID
        where CELL.SCENE_ID = #{sceneId}
    </select>
    <select id="getVenueHistResults"
            resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.nbi.impl.bean.AllocResult">
        SELECT #{sceneId}                as sceneId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.NE_ID        as gNodeBId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.CELL_ID      as cellId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.PACKAGE_ID   as packageId,
               ALLOC_RESULT.ALLOC_RESULT as result,
               ALLOC_RESULT.REMARK       as remark
        FROM T_MBB_VENUE_ALLOC_RESULT ALLOC_RESULT
                 INNER JOIN T_MBB_ALLOC_EVA_TASK_PACKAGE TASK_PACKAGE
                            ON ALLOC_RESULT.TASK_ID = TASK_PACKAGE.TASK_ID AND
                               ALLOC_RESULT.PACKAGE_ID = TASK_PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID
        WHERE ALLOC_RESULT.TASK_ID =
              (SELECT ALLOC_TASK_ID FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_TASK WHERE SCENE_ID = #{sceneId} order by TASK_ID DESC LIMIT 1
            )
        ORDER BY ALLOC_RESULT.NE_ID, ALLOC_RESULT.CELL_ID, ALLOC_RESULT.PACKAGE_ID
    </select>
</mapper>
", "filePath": "/app/code/CodeBenchRepos/implements/nbi/src/main/resources/mybatis/zenith/CapacityDBMapper.xml"}
